text: Announced by the Province of Ontario in 2019, the proposed Ontario Line is one of four priority transit projects Metrolinx is leading for the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). The line will be the largest single expansion in Toronto’s subway history, helping to ease congestion on existing transit lines throughout the city, and bring transit to underserviced neighbourhoods. The Ontario Line will bring 15.6 kilometres of much-needed subway service to Toronto to make moving around the city better, faster, and easier than it is today. The line will stretch across the city, from Exhibition Place to the future Eglinton Crosstown Light rail transit (LRT) line at Don Mills Road and Eglington Ave. The Ontario Line will have 15 stations including 6 interchange stations, and over 40 new connections to GO train services, existing subway, streetcar, and bus services.
